domain_restrictions: x ranges over all real numbers
f is defined for every real input (so x + 1 is also a real input)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: If f is 1-periodic on all real numbers (f(x + 1) equals f(x) for every real x) and P(z) holds for some integer z, then P(z + 1) holds for that same integer z.
quantifier_order: for all real x: f(x + 1) = f(x)
there exists integer z such that P(z) holds
conclude P(z + 1) for that same z

variables.name: z
variables.role: argument index for predicate P in the assumption and conclusion

variables.name: f
variables.role: periodic function used only through the equation f(x + 1) = f(x)
variables.type: function from real numbers to (unspecified codomain)

variables.name: P
variables.role: property assumed at z and concluded at z + 1

witness_dependencies: The integer z used in the conclusion is the same z as in the assumption P(z); it does not depend on x.

statement_nl: Assume that for every real number x, f(x + 1) = f(x), and assume P(z) for some integer z. Then P(z + 1).
